job.title: Frontend Developer - Fresher (Mobile-First Web)
job.description: KisanVani is an AgriTech startup in Noida building lightweight, multilingual web portals for rural and semi-urban users. We are looking for a Fresher Frontend Developer who understands offline-first concepts, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), Service Workers, and responsive lightweight JavaScript.
